name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: a configurable area above the prompt, a context bar, lossless output cleanup, session handoff notes, and per-project rule enforcement

plugins.name: modbar
plugins.description: Draws the area above the prompt for other mods: their blocks, packed into configurable rows

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: The context window as a stacked bar with its percentage and a legend, drawn by modbar

plugins.name: context-diet
plugins.description: Removes escape codes, progress redraws and identical-line runs from Bash output (lossless), and lists the biggest items in context

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: A note per project folder for the next session: /handoff writes a full one; exit can save a quick one (/handoff auto on)

plugins.name: rules-enforcer
plugins.description: Enforces a project's .claude/rules.json: required skills before edits, and doc updates in the same turn
